description: SO2 flux of MAYON volcano, from the NOVAC data-base is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Chalmers tekniska högskola. This data-set presents volcanic gas emission data from NOVAC, the global Network for Observation of Volcanic and Atmospheric Change. For each volcano, data from one or several NOVAC Scanning mini-DOAS instruments are combined with meteorological information to derive daily statistics of total SO2 emission from the volcano. Coverage: Chalmers tekniska högskola. The publisher named on the listing is Chalmers tekniska högskola. Its keywords include Volcanic SO2 degassing, Climatology / Meteorology / Atmosphere, Chalmers University of Technology, SO2 flux. The listing shows 2020-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
